entities.name: WLAN offload indication
entities.description: Indicates if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s).

entities.name: Message containing WLAN offload indication
entities.description: The message that includes the WLAN offload indication IE when the network wishes to indicate WLAN offload permission.

entities.name: Network wishes to indicate WLAN offload
entities.description: Condition when the network wishes to indicate if UE is allowed to offload traffic to WLAN.

relations.description: The message includes the WLAN offload indication IE when the network wishes to indicate WLAN offload permission.
The condition that the network wishes to indicate WLAN offload guards the inclusion of the IE in the message.
